alt: A relief carving of an eagle half finished on a CNC router bed, the left half still stepped from roughing, the right half smooth
Roughing pass on a relief carving: a flat end mill has cut the design as coarse stepped terraces
Semi-finishing pass with a 1/8 inch tapered ball nose leaving a fine visible scallop pattern across the relief
Final finishing pass with a 1/16 inch tapered ball nose confined to the eagle's head, sharp beside the scalloped background
The three cutters that carve a relief, laid beside the finished panel: a flat end mill, a 1/8 inch tapered ball nose and a 1/16 inch tapered ball nose
A relief panel mid-carve on the machine, half smooth and half still roughed, with the cutter at the boundary
